beats.body: Photos, red strings, sticky notes… Our board is a mess. Let's turn it into an **ER model** — then into real tables.

- An **entity** is a real-world thing (a person, a farm stay, a booking).
- **Attributes** describe it (name, area, check-in time).
- A **key attribute** identifies each entity uniquely (an id).
- An **entity type** is the group of similar entities (all persons).

beats.prompt: Sort the sticky notes: is each one an **entity type** or an **attribute**?

beats.body: Relationships connect entity types: **one-to-one (1:1)**, **one-to-many (1:N)**, **many-to-many (M:N)**. The **cardinality ratio** says which one.

beats.prompt: Draw the red strings: pick the cardinality of each relationship.

A farm stay and its bookings (one farm, many bookings)

beats.body:
```sql
CREATE TABLE table_name (c1 t1 NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, ...);
CREATE TABLE table2 (c1 t1 NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, c2 t2,
  FOREIGN KEY (c2) REFERENCES table1(c3) ON DELETE CASCADE);
```
A **foreign key** can only hold values that exist in the referenced primary key.
`ON DELETE CASCADE`: delete a parent row and its child rows go too. (Foreign keys are switched on here, like on our platform.)
